description: Bring your organisation’s authorised WatchMyCompetitor intelligence into ChatGPT. Ask about tracked companies, recent competitor activity, product launches and market signals; compare strategic moves; and create evidence-backed executive briefings with source links. The plugin is read-only and only accesses the WMC account associated with the authenticated user. An active WatchMyCompetitor subscription and configured user account are required.

defaultPrompt: Summarise the five most important competitor alerts from the last 30 days, with dates, commercial impact and WMC links.
What has Krones done in the last 30 days? Summarise the most important activity in date order and include WMC source links.
Create an executive briefing of recent competitor moves: three key signals, commercial impact, next actions and WMC sources.
